bug_description.original: MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value in LoadTGA at tga.cpp:301:36. Uninitialized value was created by a heap allocation at tga.cpp:218:51.
bug_description.normalized: In the TGA RLE decoder, when a raw pixel packet is encountered, s.readRawData(dst, count) may return fewer bytes than requested due to a truncated input stream. The return value is discarded without validation, leaving portions of the malloc-allocated image buffer uninitialized. These uninitialized bytes are later read and used as pixel data during image format conversion.

source.description: Reads raw pixel data from the attacker-controlled stream into the image buffer. When the stream is truncated, readRawData returns fewer bytes than count, leaving part of the buffer uninitialized.
source.value_from: attacker-controlled TGA file stream (truncated input causing short read into heap buffer)

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.code: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
sink.description: Uninitialized byte from the image buffer is used as a palette index in qRgb computation, triggering MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value.

root_cause.description: The return value of readRawData (number of bytes actually read) is discarded. No check for short read and no memset to zero-fill the unread portion of the buffer. The fix captures the return value and zero-fills any unread portion.

tainted_value_origin.note: malloc returns uninitialized heap memory; the buffer content is indeterminate until explicitly written

parser_admitted.note: info.rle is true (TGA_TYPE_RLE_INDEXED/RGB/GREY), entering the RLE decode path where the vulnerable raw-packet branch lives

fine_trace.note: Allocates size bytes of heap memory for the decoded image. malloc returns uninitialized memory; all bytes are indeterminate until explicitly written.

In the RLE raw-packet branch (c & 0x80 == 0), reads count bytes from the attacker-controlled stream into dst (which points into the image buffer). The stream is truncated, so readRawData returns fewer bytes than count, leaving the remainder of the count-sized region uninitialized.

The return value of readRawData (actual bytes read) is discarded. No validation detects the short read and no memset zero-fills the gap. dst advances by the full count, permanently skipping the uninitialized region.
After the RLE loop completes, the pixel conversion loop iterates over the image buffer. src points into the uninitialized region left by the short read. Loads an indeterminate byte into idx.

fine_trace.code: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
fine_trace.note: Uninitialized idx is used as a palette index in arithmetic (3 * idx + 2) and as an array subscript. MSAN detects the use of the uninitialized value here at column 36.

poc.trigger: Crafted 116-byte TGA file with RLE-indexed image type whose stream is truncated before all raw pixel data is provided, causing readRawData short read in the RLE decode loop.

format.name: TGA
format.contract: A TGA file with an RLE-encoded image type (image_type 9, 10, or 11) containing a raw packet (header byte with bit 7 clear) whose declared pixel count exceeds the remaining bytes in the stream, triggering a short read that leaves heap buffer bytes uninitialized.
